import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset

# Set the style

# Create a boxplot to visualize the distribution of sleep duration across different BMI categories
sns.boxplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, palette='Set2')

# Add a title and labels

plt.xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axes
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a boxplot to visualize the distribution of sleep duration across different BMI categories
sns.boxplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, palette='Set2')

# Add a title and labels
plt.title('Distribution of Sleep Duration Across BMI Categories', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)

# Save the plot as a PNG file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
